_comment: Master Miner ranks (Phase 5). A rank is derived from how many skills the child has mastered and which zones are finished; it is never saved. Listed from lowest to highest. 'min_mastered' is the fewest mastered skills for the rank; 'needs_zone' (optional) is a zone that must be finished too; 'all_zones' (optional) needs every zone finished. The highest rank whose conditions hold wins. 'line_id' is the rank's name in text/lines.csv.
